source.releaseTimeReview: THC-ENC-181–185 were checked at release time on 2026-08-26. Cannabis-specific architecture and pruning evidence is separated from general plant branching and mechanobiology evidence. The public lessons do not assert a universal node count, calendar schedule, bend angle, topping height, training frequency, or guaranteed yield response. Low-stress training is identified as cultivation terminology rather than a standardized cannabis research treatment.
